about.move: Drag a current task bar to move its dates by whole days. The server checks the exact move and saves it only when nothing needs review; anything else stays for you to review. Click a bar or press Enter to open the task. Edit dates opens the full date editor.
about.neutral: A dotted grey arrow links visible dates when the finish-to-start check is undecided because a date is missing.

connectors.svgLabel: Dependency arrows: {{aligned}} aligned, {{conflicts}} in conflict, {{neutral}} undecided

move.blockedByTaskDraft: This task has a date draft or a move being saved. Finish or discard it first; other bars can still move. Edit dates is still available.
move.failed: Moved dates for {{title}} were not saved.
move.needsReview: Moved dates for {{title}} need review before they are saved.
